 The major parties are pitching their policies to voters just two days before early voting opens in the Victorian election. With just 12 days to go before the election, Labor's primary vote shows little sign of turning around.
 The Liberals have announced proposed new anti-stalking laws, dubbed Celeste's Law after murder victim Celeste Manno.
